question: The Sangeet Natak Akademi is India's national academy for music, dance and drama. It was created by a resolution of the (then) __________, Government of India, in 1952 with Dr P.V. Rajamannar as its first Chairman.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Ministry of Education**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The Sangeet Natak Akademi is India's national academy for music, dance, and drama.
 
• It was established in 1952 by a resolution of the Ministry of Education, Government of India.
